% Graphics in boxes saved with lrbox, \sbox, and \savebox, placed in a
% TikZ node: a PNG, a PDF, a JPEG, and an EPS. The same kind of box placed
% in the text keeps its picture as an image of the page. Graphics typed
% inside a picture: a TikZ node, a LaTeX picture, and an overpic.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{overpic}
\usepackage{pict2e}
\usepackage{tikz}
\newsavebox{\keep}
\begin{document}
Before lrbox png.
\begin{lrbox}{\keep}\begin{minipage}{0.8\linewidth}
Some text.
\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{test-bare.png}\end{center}
\end{minipage}\end{lrbox}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw,rounded corners] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After lrbox png.

Before lrbox pdf.
\begin{lrbox}{\keep}\begin{minipage}{0.8\linewidth}
More text.
\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{test-overpic-box.pdf}\end{center}
\end{minipage}\end{lrbox}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw,rounded corners] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After lrbox pdf.

Before sbox jpg.
\sbox{\keep}{\includegraphics[height=30pt]{test-overpic-photo.jpg}}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After sbox jpg.

Before savebox eps.
\savebox{\keep}{\includegraphics[width=72pt]{test-inputname-epsf.eps}}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After savebox eps.

Before text copy.
\begin{lrbox}{\keep}\begin{minipage}{0.8\linewidth}
Kept text.
\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{test-bare.png}\end{center}
\end{minipage}\end{lrbox}
\usebox{\keep}

After text copy.

Before node png.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}

After node png.

Before picture pdf.
\setlength{\unitlength}{1pt}
\begin{picture}(80,60)
\put(0,0){\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}}
\put(10,10){R}
\end{picture}

After picture pdf.

Before overpic png.
\begin{overpic}[width=80pt]{test-bare.png}\put(10,10){A}\end{overpic}

After overpic png.
\end{document}
